name: Montage Laguna Beach
insider_take: Perched dramatically on 30-acre bluffs overlooking the Pacific, this Arts & Crafts-style resort feels like a seaside sanctuary where California's artistic soul meets coastal luxury.
whats_special: The resort sits on the exact location where Laguna Beach's famous Pageant of the Masters has been held since 1932. The hotel's architecture pays homage to the area's artist colony heritage with handcrafted details and locally-inspired artwork throughout. Its clifftop setting offers unobstructed views of Catalina Island on clear days.
pro_tip: Book a treatment at Spa Montage during sunset hours - the clifftop spa pavilions offer stunning golden hour views over the Pacific that you'll remember forever.
dont_miss: The secret beach access via the resort's private pathway to Table Rock Beach, one of Laguna's most secluded coves. Also explore the nearby Crystal Cove tide pools at low tide, and catch the world-famous Pageant of the Masters art festival if visiting in summer (July-August).
pros: Stunning oceanfront location with dramatic clifftop views
World-class spa featuring authentic treatments and ocean views
Elegant Arts & Crafts architecture blending with natural surroundings
cons: Premium luxury pricing reflecting exclusive resort status
Limited nearby dining options requiring resort restaurants or travel
